products.title: TRUST YOURSELF RETREAT – DEPOSIT
products.shortDescriptionHtml:
TRUST YOURSELF

A Retreat into Intuition, Discernment & the Power of Your Inner Knowing

Mount Shasta, California

May 15th – 17th, 2027

There is an intelligence within you that is communicating all the time.

Through your body.
Through your energy field.
Through your breath.
Through sensation, resonance, intuition and the subtle ways you simply know.

And yet, so many of us have been conditioned to look outside of ourselves for confirmation before trusting what we are already receiving.

Trust Yourself is a three-day immersive retreat devoted to strengthening the relationship you have with your own inner knowing.

Over our time together, we will explore intuition and discernment in a grounded, embodied way — moving beyond the idea of intuition and into the actual experience of recognising how your unique system communicates with you.

We will work with the body as an instrument of awareness and explore the internal matrix of your physical, emotional and energetic makeup. You will begin to recognise your own signals more clearly: what expansion feels like, what contraction feels like, how your body responds to truth, and how to distinguish intuitive information from fear, conditioning, expectation or the desire for external validation.

This retreat is about developing a deeper relationship with your own technology — the extraordinary intelligence already built into your body and energetic field.

Through breathwork, sound, somatic awareness, energetic practices, muscle testing, meditation and experiential exercises, we will create space for the noise to settle so that what you know can become easier to hear, feel and trust.

Sound will also be woven throughout our time together as a way of opening the field, moving energy and bringing you more deeply into resonance with yourself.

During our three days together, we will explore:

  • Intuition & Inner Knowing — recognising the different ways intuitive information may move through you and strengthening your ability to listen to it.
  • Discernment — learning to feel the difference between intuition, fear, conditioning, projection, expectation and outside influence.
  • The Intelligence of the Body — understanding the body as a living feedback system and noticing the physical and energetic signals it gives you.
  • Somatic Awareness — using sensation, movement and embodied awareness to become more present with what your system is communicating.
  • Muscle Testing & Energetic Feedback — exploring simple practices that can help you engage with the body’s innate intelligence.
  • Breathwork — using the breath to ground, regulate, open the field and create greater access to your own awareness.
  • Sound & Frequency — working with sound as a tool for clearing, activation, embodiment and deeper connection to yourself.
  • Grounding & Presence — creating a stronger relationship with your physical body so that intuitive awareness becomes something you can live from, rather than something you only access occasionally.
  • Releasing External Validation — noticing where you have learned to give your authority away and beginning to strengthen the confidence to honour what you know.
  • Your Unique Energetic Language — discovering how your system speaks to you rather than trying to experience intuition the way someone else does.

At the heart of this retreat is a simple intention:

To bring you back into relationship with yourself.

There will always be information around us. There will always be opinions, teachers, readings, algorithms, predictions and people willing to tell us what they believe is true.

The deeper invitation is learning how to meet all of that information while remaining connected to your own centre.

What resonates?
What does your body tell you?
What opens your field?
What contracts it?
What do you know before anyone else confirms it?

The more intimately you understand your own energetic language, the less you need the outside world to tell you who you are, what you feel or what your next step should be.

Trust Yourself is an opportunity to spend three days practising exactly that — listening, feeling, experiencing, discerning and remembering how much wisdom already lives within you.

I would love to welcome you into this experience.

May 2027 · Mount Shasta, California
Three-day immersive retreat with Aurora Luna Star

products.title: Seraphim & the Elohim
products.shortDescriptionHtml:
Seraphim & the Elohim: Angelic Activations
A 4-Week Online Journey | Saturdays June 6th – June 27th @ 10am Pacific
products.descriptionHtml:
I am so honored to invite you into a brand new sacred container:
Seraphim & the Elohim: Angelic Activations — a four-week immersive journey into the frequencies of the Angelic Realms and the divine architecture of creation itself.

Beginning Saturday, June 6th through June 27th, we will gather each week to open into the presence, wisdom, healing, and activational frequencies of the Seraphim and Elohim consciousness.

The Seraphim are ancient celestial beings of divine light, purification, and sacred fire — helping us dissolve density, awaken the heart, and reconnect to higher states of remembrance.

The Elohim are creator beings connected to divine manifestation, consciousness architecture, and the energetic foundations of reality itself. Their frequencies assist in the awakening of our original blueprint and the embodiment of greater alignment, clarity, creation, and soul expansion.

Throughout these four Saturdays together, we will journey through:

✨ Angelic transmissions and channeling
✨ Light language activations
✨ Energetic recalibration and nervous system support
✨ Divine remembrance and soul awakening
✨ Healing frequencies from the Seraphim and Elohim realms
✨ Guided journeys and multidimensional connection

This experience is designed to help you deepen your connection to the Angelic realms while activating greater clarity, intuition, creativity, peace, and energetic embodiment within your life.

Whether you are newer to this work or have been walking the path for years, this container will meet you exactly where you are.

The Angelic realms are calling many people forward right now to remember their light, their voice, and their sacred role in the creation of a new reality.

products.title: RECORDINGS: Galactic Gathering: Alcyone
products.descriptionHtml:
This Galactic Gathering is an immersive energetic experience working with the Solar Deities of Alcyone the Collective beings of the Great Central Sun.

Through channeled transmissions, light language activations, and guided journeys, this container is designed to awaken the solar codes within your field — activating clarity, personal power, and deeper embodiment of your light.

These recorded sessions work beyond the mind, engaging directly with your energetic and cellular systems to support:

• Activation of dormant light codes
• Recalibration to higher-frequency solar energies
• Release of outdated patterns and timelines
• Strengthening of your inner authority and creative force

This is not passive work. It is an invitation into embodiment, remembrance, and expansion.

You are not here to receive something new. You are here to unlock what has always been within you.

products.title: RECORDINGS: The Changing World – Three Part Series
products.shortDescriptionHtml: GET UNSTUCK AND MOVE SOME BIG ENERGY IS THIS THREE PART SERIES!
products.descriptionHtml:
THE CHANGING WORLD

This series is a space to reconnect with the foundations that truly support you—so you’re not just reacting to what’s happening, but consciously creating within it.

Here’s what we’ll be moving through together:

Part 1: Grounding
Coming back into the body. Realigning to how to stay present, centered, and rooted—no matter what’s happening around you.

Part 2: Heart Resonance
Keeping the heart open, even in moments of fear or confusion. You’ll receive tools to stay connected to your truth and your compassion.

Part 3: Abundance
Understanding abundance as a state of alignment. When you are grounded and heart-centered, creation begins to flow naturally.

products.title: Galactic Gathering: Orion
products.shortDescriptionHtml:
Galactic Gathering: Orion
Saturdays | April 4 – April 25 | 10:00 AM Pacific

You are invited into a sacred space of remembrance, activation, and cosmic connection.

During this four-week Galactic Gathering, we will journey together into the frequencies of the Annunaki and the Mintakan star lineage—two powerful streams of galactic intelligence that hold profound keys for humanity’s evolution at this time.

Each week we will open the field and explore these energies through:

  • Guided Meditations to reconnect with your galactic origins

  • Energetic Activations to awaken dormant codes within your light body

  • Channelled Messages and Teachings from the these Star Beings and the galactic realms

  • Light Language & Sound Transmissions to support integration and alignment

  • Sacred Community Space to share, witness, and expand together
products.descriptionHtml:
The Annunaki carry ancient wisdom connected to creation templates, planetary stewardship, and the architecture of consciousness.

The Mintakans, originating from the Mintaka star system in Orion, hold the frequency of purity, harmony, and unity consciousness, reminding us of a time when humanity lived in deeper alignment with cosmic law.

Together, these frequencies support the recalibration of our inner blueprint, helping us remember who we truly are beyond the limits of this world.

This gathering is for those who feel the pull of the stars…for those who know their journey did not begin on Earth…and for those who are ready to awaken deeper layers of their soul’s mission.

products.title: RECORDINGS: Three Sessions with the Aum Ra Collective
products.shortDescriptionHtml:
Join Aurora Luna Star for a live, three-part channeled experience with the Aum Ra Collective, designed to support you through the intensity and acceleration of our current energetic landscape.

These sessions offer channeled guidance, light-code activations, and vibrational transmissions to help you move from fear and overwhelm into clarity, alignment, and embodied purpose.

The first two sessions focus on energetic insight and activation.
The final session is a live Q&A, offering direct guidance from the Collective for those attending in real time.

products.title: RECORDINGS: The Halls of Amenti Part I
products.shortDescriptionHtml:
Signing up for the Halls of Amenti Mystery School offers a unique opportunity to embark on a transformative spiritual journey that delves into ancient wisdom and esoteric teachings.

We explored profound concepts that foster personal growth, enhance spiritual awareness, and connect with soul star guidance.

Through practical techniques and meditations/ activations, we gained valuable tools to empower our lives and navigate challenges with greater clarity.

Whether seeking deeper understanding, personal transformation, or a sense of belonging, this experience promises to enrich your spiritual path and unlock your potential within!
products.descriptionHtml: Join the six week journey as we dive into the Mystery School of the Halls of Amenti!

products.shortDescriptionHtml:
Dear Starseed,
In this four-part journey you will find that there are two videos for each section. The first video contains the download of information or theme that you will be working with. I encourage you to work on each section one week at a time so that you can use the information in the videos to shift your vibration.
